description: Create an HTTPS webhook for fills/positions/agent events. Returns signing_secret once.

events.description: Events: order.filled, position.opened, position.closed (every live close: app, agent, take-profit/stop-loss, liquidation, market resolution; close_reason is liquidation, market_resolved or null), position.liquidated, agent.decision, agent.error.

idempotency_key.description: Optional stable retry key. Reuse it after an interrupted registration.

url.description: Public HTTPS URL. No localhost/private IPs.

name: create_webhook
